action.action: Place one productive forage plant near the blocked rabbit's home

assessment.detail: Woodland and Thicket margins give Berries their best recovery. This site supports 128% of standard capacity.
assessment.title: Rich habitat

trigger.detail: Nearby plants cannot regrow enough food for another rabbit. Add productive forage at this home; waiting alone will not raise its capacity.

before_status.detail: Nearby plants cannot regrow enough food for another rabbit. Add productive forage at this home; waiting alone will not raise its capacity.

method: Actual GameHUD and WorldView on default GameSystems seed240821; ordinary initial inventory placements. At30s, place one earned berry bush using the same helper as the hint-response telemetry.

birth_status.detail: Can become a parent in about 12 meadow seconds, once fed and near another ready adult.
